patch_description: This candidate rewrites the entangling block to use a pruned 1D "zig-zag" ladder of CZ gates. By eliminating the cyclic (7,0) connection, we slightly lower the gate count and depth overhead while preserving full multi-qubit entanglement and connectivity through staggered adjacent pairings. Additionally, the trailing rotation layer utilizes RX gates instead of RZ gates. Because RX does not commute with the Z-based entanglement of the CZs and the IsingZZ feature uploads, it forces a stronger basis change that has empirically demonstrated faster training convergence and ultimately better test loss in prior trials.
